name: pixeloven
description: PixelOven's plugins for Claude Code and Codex — the agent foundation, the knowledge substrate, and the design system.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Portable agent methodology: 7 crew roles, planning/review/orchestration disciplines, onboarding, doctor and learn. Needs no platform; stack conventions ship as packs (infra-skills).

plugins.name: infra-skills
plugins.description: Crew skills pack: Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes (Kustomize, workloads) and GitHub Actions conventions, with estate choices deferred to the project's local skills.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Brand assets and design-system usage: the tokens, typography and component conventions a consuming project applies.

plugins.name: comfyui-docker
